issues.summary: SQLite foreign key enforcement is never enabled, so declared REFERENCES constraints are not actually honoured at runtime.
issues.fix: Execute PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON immediately after opening every SqliteConnection and add a negative test that an invalid module_fqn or procedure_fqn insert fails.

issues.summary: Comment stripping is regex-based and can remove apostrophes or REM inside VBA string literals, producing incorrect body_hash_md5 values and false duplicate matches.
issues.fix: Replace the regex comment remover with a token-aware normalizer that tracks VBA string-literal state and strips comments only when apostrophe/REM occur outside strings; add tests for apostrophes and REM inside string constants.

issues.summary: The test suite is materially weaker than the Session 1 spec: it does not assert the exact probe-target shapes or the required dead-code/deferral/schema/foreign-key behaviors.
issues.fix: Add exact assertions for the seven m_lng*/m_str* module variables and the two local Dims, verify signature_string text for GetString, add dead-code detector tests for after-Exit/after-Goto/If False Then, prove deferred modules are not parsed, assert schema columns/indexes, assert FK enforcement, and add a deterministic-canonical-choice dedup test.

issues.summary: Property Get/Let/Set procedures with the same VBA property name are persisted under the same Symbols.fqn, which makes paired property accessors collide and dead-code lookup ambiguous.
issues.fix: Encode accessor kind into the persisted property FQN (#get/#let/#set suffix) and update FindResolverProcedure to match property symbols by name plus accessor kind.

issues.summary: Statistics and the measurement report counted procedure-local Dim rows as module variables because all kind='module_var' symbols were aggregated together.
issues.fix: Filter ModuleVarCount to declared_in_fqn IS NULL; add a separate Local vars column to the per-module breakdown.
